hcontainer.p: (218) In particular, the Commission should initiate the procedure for suspension or repeal in case of: (a) indications that organisations that have received personal data from the Union under this Decision do not comply with the Principles and that such non-compliance is not effectively addressed by the competent oversight and enforcement bodies; (b) indications that the U.S. authorities do not comply with the applicable conditions and limitations for access by U.S. public authorities for law enforcement and national security purposes to personal data transferred under the EU-U.S. DPF ; or (c) failure to effectively address complaints by Union data subjects, including by the ODNI CLPO and/or the DPRC.
